english.title: Postal service - fail to leave post office when required to do so
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without reasonable excuse, failed to leave a universal postal service post office or related premises, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), when required to do so by a person, namely **(..SPECIFY NAME..), who was engaged in the business of a universal service provider, and who reasonably suspected you of obstructing the course of business of a universal service provider
english.legislation: Contrary to section 88(3) and (4) of the Postal Services Act 2000.

english.notes:
(i) A person who commits an offence under this Section may be removed from the premises by any person engaged in the business of a universal service provider.
(ii) Any constable shall on demand remove, or assist in removing, any person required to leave under this Section
(iii) See Section 86(4) for "universal postal service" and "universal postal service post office".
(iv) See Section 88(6) for "related premises"
